Manage YouTube videos. Use this tool to list, upload, update, delete, get rating, or report videos.

Usage:
  yutu video [flags]
  yutu video [command]

Available Commands:
  delete      Delete videos
  getRating   Get video ratings
  insert      Upload a video
  list        List videos
  rate        Rate a video
  reportAbuse Report abuse on a video
  update      Update a video

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for video

Use "yutu video [command] --help" for more information about a command.
